purpose: value of jointly searching generic display functions and the 70-pair matching, not a 2-second submission
input_generator: Python random: uniform 32-of-64 barcodes, no consecutive repeated orders; not official same-number seed
rule_family: 30 balanced two-paper and 90 balanced four-paper rules
neighborhood: one unprotected window, or coherent changes of all unprotected windows sharing an original comparison edge
pair_objective: 0.65 * handle Hamming + exact legal generic distances for BOTH requests + 0.04 * full Hamming, summed over 70 pairs
conditional_matching: exact cardinality 70, LP bound and MILP when necessary; proof required
primary_comparison: mixed-selected vs linear-selected: 10 candidate designs each, with 6 shared designs
mixed_selection_pool: original, pair-only, linear ranks 0..3, nonlinear ranks 0..3
secondary: raw candidates, baseline, pair-only, and union-selected
online_engine: retained imp-lean/frontier-lattice planning, force exact BFS generic path for all arms, no time cutoff

secondary_nonmonotone_search.selection: best model state, not test score

precision_extension.SE: across 32 per-problem averages, not 256 independent patterns
